municipality: ALL (national; FKG theme 5710 'Skoledistrikt', 98 municipalities incl. all 20 target municipalities)
provider: GeoDanmark / GeoFA (Geografiske Fagdata, Fælleskommunalt geodatasamarbejde FKG), published on opendata.dk as 'Skoledistrikter (98 kommuner)'
urlTemplate: https://geofa.geodanmark.dk/api/v2/sql/fkg?q=SELECT udd_distrikt_navn, kommunekode, udd_distrikt_nr FROM fkg.t_5710_born_skole_dis WHERE statuskode=3 AND udd_distrikt_type_kode=5 AND starttrin_kode=11 AND ST_Intersects(geometri, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lng},{lat}),4326),25832))
urlTemplateNote: URL-encode q. Add &srs=4326 and select geometri to get WGS84 geometry back. Filters: statuskode=3 = 'Gældende / Vedtaget' (Hvidovre also has many 'Ikke gældende / Aflyst' rows), udd_distrikt_type_kode=5 = 'Skole' (Hvidovre also has 'Børne' districts), starttrin_kode=11 = starts at 0. klasse (excludes 10.-klasse and 7.-9. overbygning districts, e.g. Lyngby-Taarbæk Trongårdsskolen 7-9, Dragør Nordstrandskolen 10.). No API key needed for this public layer.
inputCRS: EPSG:4326 lng/lat (transformed server-side; native CRS EPSG:25832)

cors.note: also sends access-control-allow-credentials: true; use fetch without credentials

caveats: Gentofte (157) and Rødovre (175) each publish a single municipality-wide polygon ('Gentofte', 'Rødovre kommune'): these municipalities no longer use per-school districts (see separate entries). Result is useless for school assignment there.
Frederiksberg data is from 2022-09-29 (9 districts; Tre Falke Skolen has no district).
Brøndby (2019), Albertslund/Høje-Taastrup/Furesø (2021) not updated recently; districts may have changed.
Rudersdal has a combined district 'Birkerød/Søholm/Rude Skov' (several schools share one polygon).
District names are municipal free text (e.g. Gladsaxe uses 'Buddinge' not 'Buddinge Skole'; Furesø 'Syvstjerne'); match to register by fuzzy name + kommunekode.
Small slivers between neighbouring polygons exist (e.g. Frederiksberg) - a point may rarely hit 2 districts.

method: WFS 1.1.0 GetFeature with tiny BBOX around point
urlTemplateNote: WFS 1.1.0 + EPSG:4326 => axis order lat,lon in BBOX. OGC FILTER/Intersects requests fail (Invalid SRS / ignored in 1.0.0); CQL not supported. BBOX returns all statuses and full geometry, so filter statuskode==3 && udd_distrikt_type_kode==5 client-side and do point-in-polygon. Full download (no BBOX) is ~140 MB - use the SQL API with kommunekode filter instead.

method: WFS 1.0.0 GetFeature with CQL_FILTER point intersect
urlTemplateNote: The SRID=4326; prefix is required - a bare POINT(lng lat) is interpreted in native EPSG:25832 and returns nothing. Omit propertyName to get geometry. Full layer (57 features) in WGS84 is ~385 KB: same URL without CQL_FILTER.
inputCRS: EPSG:4326 lng/lat via SRID=4326 prefix (native EPSG:25832)
otherUsefulProperties: skoleid (institution number, matches register.json id; comma-separated list for 'Distrikt Ørestad' which is shared by 4 schools)

provider: Frederiksberg Kommune GC2 (gc2ekstern.frederiksberg.dk, backend of kort.frederiksberg.dk), layer buo.skoledistrikter_2022
method: GC2 SQL API (GET) point-in-polygon; WFS also works
urlTemplate: https://gc2ekstern.frederiksberg.dk/api/v2/sql/frederiksberg?q=SELECT udd_dis_na, skolekode FROM buo.skoledistrikter_2022 WHERE ST_Intersects(geom, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lng},{lat}),4326),25832))
caveats: Only 8 districts, no 'Skolen på Duevej' polygon, which leaves a hole; geometries otherwise identical to GeoFA (layer last modified 2022-10-18).
opendata.dk dataset 'Skoledistrikter 2025' (skoledistrikter_frederiksberg, created 2026-02-17) exists but its GeoJSON resource has an empty URL - not downloadable.

method: ArcGIS REST MapServer query, point intersect
urlTemplateNote: Add outSR=4326&returnGeometry=true (or f=geojson) for polygons. Returns SEVERAL overlapping 'oplande' - each school's 2.5 km catchment.
policy: Gentofte has no per-school districts (trial through 2027/28): school starters are allocated by sibling guarantee, family wish and proximity; 0.-3. klasse are offered schools within 2.5 km walking distance. Source: https://gentofte.dk/boern-og-unge/skole/skoleindskrivning/ ; lookup app https://gentofte.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/lookup/index.html?appid=c4ea04bd1a06451386d4ce701b89d99e

method: rule-based: one common district since 2024/25; right to a school within max 2 km of the home address. Compute distance from address to the 6 folkeskoler (register.json lat/lng).
note: Quote: 'De seks folkeskoler er overgået til et fælles skoledistrikt fra skoleåret 2024/2025'. Distance map: https://rk.dk/borger/bolig-og-by/digitale-kort/digitale-kort-skoler (not tested as an API). GeoFA contains only one municipality-wide polygon 'Rødovre kommune'.

/skoledistrikter and /skoledistrikt return 404. adgangsadresser/reverse returns sogn, afstemningsområde, politikreds, retskreds, opstillingskreds, storkreds, zone, jordstykke - but no skoledistrikt. DAGI has no school districts. Useful only for address geocoding to lng/lat (e.g. https://api.dataforsyningen.dk/adresser?q=...&struktur=mini).
